calibrated_validation.description: The user named being cut out of their mother's care — 'a clear four-day gap where I was kept out of the loop on a medication change that made Mom dizzy' — a load-bearing bid of exclusion and a loved one's health scare, but the reply is a bare process promise with zero uptake of that weight. The same person-absent process note repeats on every later turn; since the user only restates the same timeline and asks for the next draft of the same work, the skip stays at 3 rather than rising to 4.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll check prior context on the family meeting and Clara/Mom care notes so the background section matches what you've already been working from. Then I'll draft it without turning a communication gap into proven intent.
